title: Markov Modulated JSQ in Heavy Traffic Via the Poisson Equation
summary: In parallel-server systems with a single stream of arrivals (a.k.a. load balancing), Join-the-Shortest-Queue (JSQ) is a popular routing algorithm. There is extensive literature studying this system in various asymptotic regimes, but all assume constant parameters (arrival and service rates). We study the JSQ system with Markov-modulated parameters and heterogeneous servers.
